elements.label: About
elements.value: Downward acceleration applied every frame plus the terminal velocity cap.

onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/gravity_fall.schema.json, set gf_c_feel to {{gf_c_feel}}]
Apply {{gf_c_feel}} gravity preset. Light=6.0, Standard=9.8, Heavy=18.0.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/gravity_fall.schema.json, set gf_t_gravity to {{gf_t_gravity}}]
Set gravity magnitude to {{gf_t_gravity}} (applied as Vec3(0, -{{gf_t_gravity}}, 0) in CharacterForceControllerBase).

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/gravity_fall.schema.json, set gf_t_fall_speed to {{gf_t_fall_speed}}]
Set CharacterForceControllerBase.maxFallSpeed to {{gf_t_fall_speed}}.
